The '''Decipher Volunteer Squadrons''' were Decipher's volunteer program for the Star Wars Customizable Card Game. Decipher's volunteer site described them as "more than 200 key volunteers serving Star Wars Customizable Card Game communities around the world".<ref name="decsq-index">[http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/index.html Volunteers: Star Wars CCG Squadrons], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000525220411/http://www.decipher.com/volunteers/squadrons/index.html Internet Archive, 25 May 2000]</ref> Squadron members directed sanctioned tournaments and regional qualifiers, ran demos, and helped at conventions.<ref name="decsq-index" /> Each member had a squadron callsign (Red, Gold or Rogue and a number), and Flight Leaders added "FL" to it.<ref name="pc-reprint">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/decipher-swccg-squadron-members/ Decipher SWCCG Squadron Members], Players Committee reprint. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261025162059/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/decipher-swccg-squadron-members.html Internet Archive]</ref>

From August 1999 to January 2001 the site listed members on a page for each tournament region, and some members had a profile page in their own words.<ref name="decsq-index" /> For the squadron rosters see [[Squadron Members]], and for the states and countries in each region see [[SWCCG regions]].
